DeepCool PK750D 750 Watt 80 PLUS Bronze Certified Non-Modular Power Supply

Upgrade your system’s power with the DeepCool PK750D 750W Power Supply, designed to deliver stable and efficient performance for modern PCs. With 80 PLUS Bronze certification, it ensures up to 85% energy efficiency, reducing excess heat and power waste.

The DeepCool PK750D 750 W 80 PLUS Bronze Power Supply is a robust and efficient non-modular unit designed to power modern mid- to high-range desktop builds. Certified 80 PLUS Bronze, it delivers up to 85% efficiency at typical load, reducing waste heat and saving energy. Its active PFC and DC-to-DC conversion topology ensures stable output across the +3.3V and +5V rails, which improves compatibility with contemporary hardware. The 120 mm Hypro-bearing fan offers reliable and quiet cooling, while the PSU’s durable construction includes Taiwan-made capacitors and a comprehensive protection suite (OVP, OCP, SCP, OPP, UVP, and OTP) to safeguard your system. Built to function in ambient temperatures up to 40 °C and altitudes up to 5,000 m, the PK750D supports demanding operating environments. With a 5-year warranty and a compact 150 × 140 × 86 mm form factor, this PSU offers dependable performance and long-term value for gaming rigs, content creation desktops, or other power-hungry builds.
